business_summary: Technovator International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides urban energy saving services in the People's Republic of China. It operates through three segments: Smart Transportation, Smart Buildings and Complex, and Smart Energy. The Smart Transportation segment offers a series of proprietary software and hardware products of rail transit, such as integrated supervision and control systems; and building automation systems for rail transit and safety door systems, as well as integrated solutions comprising planning, procurement, installation, commissioning, and aftersales services. The Smart Building and Complex segment engages in the integrated intelligence and efficiency management activities, including integrated energy consumption monitoring; energy-saving consultation and reformation services; integration and product supply of intelligence systems for buildings; and provision of full life-cycle services. The Smart Energy segment offers regional energy planning, integrated utilization of industrial waste heat recovery, heat pump, independent temperature and humidity control, and variable air rate technologies for energy cascade utilization, as well as optimizes and transforms energy systems; and urban heating network technologies, including heating network and source monitoring, optimal regulation, distributed variable frequency heating, cooling and heating network balancing, and combined multi-heat sources heating technologies. It is involved in the design, manufacture, and marketing of building automation solutions; development of software and technology, as well as marketing, service, and consulting activities; energy management activities; and marketing of heating power equipment. The company was formerly known as Technovator Int Private Ltd. and changed its name to Technovator International Limited in September 2011. Technovator International Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Singapore.
business_summary_ko: Technovator International Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 도시 에너지 절약 서비스를 제공합니다. 스마트 교통, 스마트 빌딩 및 복합, 스마트 에너지의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 스마트 운송 부문은 통합 감독 및 제어 시스템과 같은 철도 운송의 일련의 독점 소프트웨어 및 하드웨어 제품을 제공합니다. 철도 운송 및 안전 도어 시스템을 위한 빌딩 자동화 시스템뿐만 아니라 계획, 조달, 설치, 시운전 및 애프터 서비스로 구성된 통합 솔루션도 포함됩니다. 스마트 빌딩 및 복합 단지 부문은 통합 에너지 소비 모니터링을 포함한 통합 인텔리전스 및 효율성 관리 활동에 참여합니다. 에너지 절약 상담 및 개선 서비스; 건물용 지능 시스템의 통합 및 제품 공급; 그리고 완전한 라이프사이클 서비스 제공. 스마트 에너지 부문은 지역 에너지 계획, 산업 폐열 회수의 통합 활용, 열 펌프, 독립적인 온도 및 습도 제어, 에너지 다단계 활용을 위한 가변 공기율 기술을 제공할 뿐만 아니라
